# Chapter 11 — 他比我大三岁 (He Is Three Years Older Than Me)

**Pinyin:** Tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì  
**Source:** *HSK Standard Course 2*, printed pages 81–88 (source image pages 101–108).

## New Words

| No. | Chinese | Pinyin | English | Source |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 唱歌 | chànggē | v. to sing; to sing a song | p. 82 |
| 2 | 男 | nán | adj. man; male | p. 82 |
| 3 | 女 | nǚ | adj. woman; female | p. 82 |
| 4 | 孩子 | háizi | n. child; kid | p. 82 |
| 5 | 右边 | yòubian | n. right; right side | p. 82 |
| 6 | 比 | bǐ | prep. than; (used in comparisons) | p. 82 |
| 7 | 便宜 | piányi | adj. cheap; inexpensive | p. 83 |
| 8 | 说话 | shuōhuà | v. to speak; to say; to talk | p. 83 |
| 9 | 可能 | kěnéng | aux. maybe; perhaps; probably | p. 83 |
| 10 | 去年 | qùnián | n. last year | p. 83 |
| 11 | 姓 | xìng | v. to have the family name/surname | p. 83 |

The New Words section has eleven numbered entries and no numbered subentries. The warm-up on p. 81 also practices words including 跳舞 (tiàowǔ, to dance), which is not an entry in this chapter's New Words list.

## Unique Hanzi in New Words

Distinct characters in the numbered New Words entries, listed once in order of first appearance: **唱、歌、男、女、孩、子、右、边、比、便、宜、说、话、可、能、去、年、姓** (18 characters).

## Characters

The Characters section on printed p. 87 introduces two radicals and their examples, separately from the New Words list:

- **疒** (病字头; generally related to illness): **病** (bìng, disease; to be ill) and **疯** (fēng, mad; crazy).
- **冫** (两点水; generally related to ice or cold): **冷** (lěng, cold) and **冰** (bīng, ice).
